text: In this District 3 City Council Member race, Jamie Yee's recorded questionnaire response states she supports Israeli and Palestinian safety and dignity, rejects local antisemitism and anti-Palestinian hate, and would be cautious about one-sided international resolutions. She holds an endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, a county Democratic club whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive and secure Jewish state. The guide selects Yee as the strongest candidate in this race. Reena Gupta's recorded questionnaire response states she supports Israel's existence and Israeli and Palestinian safety, rejects discriminatory city actions, and would evaluate investments through legal authority, fiduciary duties, and local purpose. Both candidates' recorded positions affirm safety and dignity for Israelis and Palestinians while expressing caution toward one-sided actions; Yee additionally carries the Jewish Democratic Club endorsement and explicitly signals wariness of one-sided international resolutions, a stance that sits in tension with stronger pro-Palestinian advocacy on divestment or ceasefire language.
